Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the sale of certain state liquor control board warehouses.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring the sale of certain state liquorcontrol board warehouses; and amending RCW 66.08.160.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 66.08.160 and 1947 c 134 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The Washington state liquor board and the state financecommittee are ((hereby)) authorized to lease ((or)), purchase, oracquire a site and erect a warehouse building in the city of Seattle,and for that purpose may borrow money and may issue bonds in an amountnot to exceed one million five hundred thousand dollars to be amortizedfrom liquor revenues over a period of not to exceed ten years. (2)(a) The board must within a commercially reasonable time sellany warehouse building that: (i) Was purchased under subsection (1) ofthis section; (ii) was purchased prior to the effective date of thisact; and (iii) is located on East Marginal Way. (b) All funds derived from the sale, less the board'sadministrative costs related to the sale, must be deposited in thestate general fund. p. 1 SB 6885 (c) Any sale of a warehouse building under this section is subjectto the competitive bidding process under RCW 43.19.1911.
